title: Private Lake Istokpoga Trophy Bass Charter in Sebring
includes: All Fishing Gear and Lures Included
Private 4-Hour Lake Istokpoga Bass Fishing Charter in Florida
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Lake Istokpoga is celebrated as one of Florida's top destinations for anglers pursuing trophy largemouth bass, offering a quieter and more natural fishing experience than many of the state's larger lakes. 

Every private charter is customized to your group's goals, whether you're landing your first bass, refining advanced techniques, or chasing the fish of a lifetime. 

Your captain provides expert local knowledge, premium rods, reels, tackle, and personalized instruction for every skill level. 

Enjoy calm freshwater conditions, flexible morning or afternoon departures, and a cooler stocked with ice and bottled water while you relax and experience one of Florida's most respected trophy bass fisheries.
